user.title: New location
user.description: A location groups devices and their maintenance tasks: main house, holiday home, pool…

add.title: Add a device
add.description: Pick an existing Home Assistant device, or type a name for a device Home Assistant does not know. A template preselects the usual tasks.

tasks.title: Tasks of {device}
tasks.description: Tick catalog tasks and/or type your own, one per field: `Label` (every month) or `Label ; 2 ; weeks`. Frequencies are then adjusted from the card.

remove.title: Remove a device
remove.description: The device's tasks and their history are deleted.

error.device_or_name: Pick a device or type a name.
error.invalid_custom_task: Invalid custom task. Use `Label` or `Label ; value ; unit` (days, weeks, months, years).
error.no_task: Select or type at least one task.

not_a_task.message: {entity_id} is not a Maintenance Hub task.

reset.name: Record maintenance
reset.description: Marks maintenance tasks as done. Handy from an NFC tag stuck next to the equipment.

last_reset.name: Date and time
last_reset.description: When the maintenance was actually done. Defaults to now.

set_frequency.name: Set frequency
set_frequency.description: Changes how often maintenance tasks come back.

value.name: Value
value.description: Number of units between two maintenances.

anchor.name: Seasonal date
anchor.description: MM-DD date the task comes back on each season (years unit only). Empty for a rolling task.

set_notify.name: Set alerts
set_notify.description: Enables or mutes the alerts of maintenance tasks.

notify.name: Alerts
notify.description: On to be alerted when the task is due.
